from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OtherCurrentLiability(BaseModel):
    """The '其他流动负债' amount from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name, as named in the report")
    liability_type: str | None = Field(description="The line-item name, as written in the report (e.g., '其他流动负债')")
    period_end_balance: float | None = Field(description="The end-of-period balance value, in reported currency unit")
    period_start_balance: float | None = Field(description="The beginning-of-period balance value, in reported currency unit")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    other_current_liabilities: list[OtherCurrentLiability]
